video_caption: The video opens with a man with dark hair, wearing a dark blue collared shirt and a white lab coat, standing in a modern kitchen. He speaks directly to the camera, making hand gestures and displaying a serious yet slightly smirking expression. Behind him are white kitchen cabinets and a light blue backsplash, with a sink and a window showing sunflowers in a vase to his right, and a glimpse of an outdoor patio through a glass door to his left. The scene then transitions to an animated sequence from Rick and Morty, showing Jerry (brown hair, green polo shirt with a brown stripe) looking agitated and wide-eyed, leaning into Morty (partially obscured, brown hair). Behind Jerry, a metal shelf holds various items, including a sign that clearly reads "TIME TRAVEL STUFF." The view then widens to show Rick (light blue hair, white lab coat) standing with his arms crossed and a bored expression, while Morty, wearing a yellow t-shirt, looks down sadly. Jerry, with his hands on his hips, appears to be confronting Rick in a cluttered workshop filled with scientific equipment, including a large machine with robotic arms and glowing green components.

A man in a white lab coat over a blue button-up shirt gestures with his right hand as he speaks, looking directly at the camera. To his right, superimposed on the screen, is the cover of a book titled "The Solar System" by Howard K. Trammel, published by Scholastic. The cover features a dark space background with the sun and several planets, including Pluto, depicted with a small green arrow pointing to text that reads "The solar system was formed 4.6 billion years ago". The man is in a modern kitchen setting with white cabinets and a light blue backsplash.

The background features white overhead cabinets, a light blue backsplash, a stainless steel sink, and a window with a vase of sunflowers on the sill. The video then returns to the man in the kitchen, who continues to speak and gesture with his hands.

The video begins with an image of five celestial bodies against a starry background, titled "Largest dwarf planets." Each body is labeled with its name (Pluto, Eris, 2007 OR10, Haumea, Makemake) and diameter in miles and kilometers. An overlay asks, "Q - Are these defined as Dwarf Planets because of their size?" (English). A male voice explains that searching for life might involve querying a database for "planets," but this would exclude interesting moons and dwarf planets like Pluto and Ceres. From 00:06, the speaker, a man wearing a white lab coat over a blue shirt, stands in a modern kitchen with white cabinets, a light blue tiled backsplash, and a window looking out onto a patio with sunflowers. He gestures with his hands as he speaks directly to the camera. At 00:15, a graphic titled "MOONS OF OUR SOLAR SYSTEM" (English) appears on the right side, showcasing various moons with their names. The man continues to gesture, looking towards the graphic. By 00:20, the moon graphic disappears, and the man further emphasizes that the definition of a "dwarf planet" doesn't aid scientific inquiry. The scene then transitions to a Google Scholar search page at 00:36, displaying search results for "dwarf planets" (English), many of which refer to "M dwarf stars" (English) or "white dwarf planets" (English), indicating a classification issue. Finally, at 00:48, a colorful image of Pluto appears on a black background next to the text "2. The 2006 Vote at the IAU General Assembly in Prague was not convincing." (English), as upbeat electronic music starts playing.

The video segment opens with a man in a white lab coat over a blue shirt, standing in a modern kitchen with white cabinets, a light blue backsplash, and a window displaying a garden and a sink with sunflowers in a vase. He speaks to the camera, gesturing with both hands. A text overlay appears, defining a planet according to the IAU in 2006, stating: "In 2006 the IAU explicitly defined a planet as '... a celestial body that (a) is in orbit around the Sun, (b) has sufficient mass for its self-gravity to overcome rigid body forces so that it assumes a hydrostatic equilibrium (nearly round) shape, and (c) has cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit.' (IAU 2006)." This text is displayed over an image of Pluto. The man reappears, gesturing with his hands. Another text overlay shows a table with headers "Assumption," "Without Forum Hall" (with "CZK/EUR" columns), "With Forum Hall" (with "CZK/EUR" columns), and "Farewell Dinner" (with "CZK/EUR" column), with rows for "Participants" (2500 and 2000) and various numerical values, followed by the text "(AND APPROX 9000 MEMBERSHIP TOTAL)". This table implies costs for conference participants. The man is briefly visible again before a "Results" text box appears, detailing resolutions from the IAU conference: "Resolution 5A: 'Definition of Planet' was not counted but was passed with a great majority. Resolution 5B: 'Definition of Classical Planet' had 91 votes in favour, but many more against so there was no count. Resolution 6A: 'Definition of Pluto-class objects' was passed with 237 votes in favour, 157 against and 17 abstentions. Resolution 6B: 'Definition of Plutonian Objects' had 183 votes in favour and 186 votes against." Specific vote counts (237 in favour, 157 against; 183 in favour, 186 against) are highlighted in yellow, and below, two percentages are shown in green: "“Pluto as Dwarf Planet” vote 60%" and "“Dwarf or Plutoid” vote 50.4%". The man reappears, explaining the closeness of the vote and that many astronomers had already left the conference before the final vote. A new text overlay appears on a black background, reading: "There is some further controversy about closed door meetings and the fact the IAU membership are not primarily planetary scientists anyway." This is followed by another text overlay with an image of Pluto, stating: "3. The new definition is already broken / lacking." The segment ends with the man shrugging and gesturing dismissively.

The video opens with a man in a white lab coat over a blue collared shirt speaking directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands in a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a light blue backsplash. He makes a circular gesture with both hands, palms facing each other. The scene transitions to a graphic displaying the "TRAPPIST-1 System," which includes a star and seven planets labeled 'b' through 'g', with the text "... not planets apparently." appearing at the bottom of the screen. This is followed by an artistic rendering of a large, reddish-brown celestial body with horizontal stripes against a starry background, accompanied by the text "not a star, but not really a planet either?". The next shot shows a smaller, striped blue-green planet, seemingly a rogue planet, drifting alone in space with the Milky Way visible in the background. The video then cuts back to the man in the kitchen, who gestures with a pinching motion, then sweeps his right hand outwards, and finally brings both hands together with fingertips touching, as he continues to explain his point.

A man in a white lab coat over a dark blue shirt stands in a modern kitchen, facing the camera and gesturing with his hands. From 00:02, he holds his hands up with curled fingers, as if holding a small object, while an animated black square with two small white dots (representing celestial bodies) appears on the right side of the screen, illustrating his explanation. He continues to gesture, bringing his hands closer and then at 00:05, he spreads his hands wide apart, palms open and fingers splayed, as if describing something large. The black square overlay then disappears, revealing the full kitchen background, which includes white cabinets, a light blue backsplash, a sink, and a window with sunflowers in a vase and light blue glasses on a shelf. He then clasps his hands together in front of him at 00:07, maintaining a serious expression.

The video opens with an animated scene depicting three primitive men in a rocky, mountainous landscape, confronting a bear emerging from a dark cave. One man in the foreground, wearing a loincloth, holds a spear, looking intently at the bear. Behind him, another man stands on a rock with a spear, while a third man on the right cliff prepares to throw a rock. The scene transitions to a live-action shot of a man with short dark hair, wearing a blue shirt and white lab coat, standing in a modern kitchen with white cabinets, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. He then references the animated scene, which reappears with the bear now depicted as a tiny, distant figure in the sky, and text overlaid on the image stating, "WE NEED TO RECLASSIFY THE BEAR NOW IT LOOKS SMALL AND UNRELATED TO THIS CAVE." The video concludes with a black screen featuring an image of Pluto on the left and white text on the right that reads: "4. Most scientists aren't using the new definition (for anything useful)."

A man in a white lab coat and blue collared shirt stands in a modern kitchen, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with his hands. The kitchen features white cabinets, a light blue backsplash, a stainless steel sink, and a window with a vase of sunflowers. An outdoor patio is visible through a sliding glass door behind him. The video then transitions through several white pages displaying black text, resembling scientific papers, where the word "planet" is highlighted in yellow or blue in different contexts, emphasizing its usage. This is followed by a black screen featuring a colorful, spherical object (Pluto) on the left, with white text on the right stating: "4. The Dwarf Planet definition has never been linked to a SIZE". The man reappears, continuing to speak and gesture, before the scene reverts to the black screen with Pluto. New white text appears, reading: "Resolution 5A, 2)" followed by a definition: "(2) A "dwarf planet" is a celestial body that (a) is in orbit around the Sun, (b) has sufficient mass for its self-gravity to overcome rigid body forces so that it assumes a hydrostatic equilibrium (nearly round) shape2, (c) has not cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit, and (d) is not a satellite." The last part of the definition, "(c) has not cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit, and (d) is not a satellite", is highlighted in yellow.

The video opens with an animated scene featuring Morty and Jerry from Rick and Morty, sitting on a carpeted floor in a living room filled with art supplies, including a drawing pad labeled "DRAW STUFF." Jerry, wearing a green striped polo, gestures emphatically while speaking, and Morty, in a yellow t-shirt, listens attentively with a slightly concerned expression. The scene then transitions to a man with dark hair, wearing a white lab coat over a blue shirt, standing in a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a light blue backsplash, speaking directly to the camera and using active hand gestures. At 0:21, the screen turns black, displaying the white text "Geophysical Planet Definition" with an image of the colorful, mottled dwarf planet Pluto to the left. The definition reads: "A planet is a substellar-mass body that has never undergone nuclear fusion and has enough gravitation to be round due to hydrostatic equilibrium, regardless of its orbital parameters." Sunglasses briefly appear on Pluto, giving it a "cool" look. The video cuts back to the man in the lab coat, who continues to explain his point with expressive hand movements. The final scene shows a split screen: the top half displays a large, black and white Great Dane looking down at a small white Chihuahua on a white background, with "Image credit: moderndogmagazine.com" in the corner. The bottom half features "DR ALAN STERN PLANETARY SCIENTIST / NASA" in a dark suit and light blue tie, speaking and gesturing from a podium in a conference room, presumably making an analogy with the dogs.

The video opens with a grainy, overlaid shot of a man in a grey suit, white shirt, and a light blue patterned tie, speaking into a microphone. He is smiling slightly and looking off-camera, while the background appears to be a large room with indistinct figures, possibly an audience, and a subtle overlay of what looks like a basketball court. The text in the lower left corner shows a blurry logo resembling a stylized "W" or "M." As the man concludes speaking, saying "Ron's rebuttal. Thank you," he nods, smiles widely, and steps back from the microphone, prompting applause from the unseen audience. The scene then transitions with a chaotic overlay of blurry crowd footage and white particles, showing three white blocks, likely awards, bearing the same logo, placed on a table, next to a yellow banner with "OS CLU" (likely part of a club name like "ROTARY CLUB") and a flag. This abruptly shifts to an animated scene from "Rick and Morty," where Rick, with spiky grey hair and a white lab coat, stands between Morty, in a yellow shirt, and Jerry, in a green and brown striped polo shirt. Rick gestures widely with open hands and wide eyes, while Jerry stands with hands on his hips. The camera then focuses on Jerry, who continues to speak, shrugging, making expressive hand gestures, and displaying various facial expressions from a smirk to wide-eyed surprise. Behind him, on a metal shelf, is a cardboard box labeled "TIME TRAVEL STUFF" and a small green horned creature. Jerry concludes his statement with a wide-mouthed, wide-eyed expression, and a buzzing sound cuts him off as the screen briefly flickers to black with some lines. The video then transitions to a live-action shot of a man with dark hair, wearing a white lab coat over a blue button-up shirt, gesturing with his right hand while looking directly at the camera. He is in a modern kitchen with white cabinets, a sink, and a large window showing outdoor greenery and sunflowers.

The video segment opens with a medium shot of a woman with dark hair, wearing a dark top, intensely focused on a silver laptop screen in a modern, well-lit office environment. Her expression is thoughtful and slightly serious as she engages with the content on her device. The scene then transitions smoothly, as the laptop screen zooms in and transforms into a dynamic animated graphic display. Prominently displayed is the text "Zukunft sichern" (Secure the future), followed by smaller text that reads "Sicher investieren mit KI" (Invest securely with AI), conveying the core message of securing one's future through AI-driven investments. The animation features clean lines, abstract digital elements, and a blue, white, and grey color scheme. Following this graphic interlude, the video cuts to a man with short dark hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt, actively holding and looking at a tablet or thin laptop. He appears engaged with the content, and a woman with dark hair and a white top is partially visible in the blurred background, also looking towards the device or the man, suggesting a shared or collaborative interaction within a similar contemporary office setting.

In the segment, a man wearing a white lab coat over a blue collared shirt is visible from the chest up, standing in what appears to be a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a light-colored countertop in the background. He has short dark hair and is looking directly at the camera, speaking with a serious but engaged expression. To his right, a circular image of the planet Pluto is displayed against a black background, showcasing its reddish-brown and white surface. At 00:04, a semi-transparent, rectangular, grid-like plane slides in from the right, visually slicing through the image of Pluto, revealing a cross-section or a different perspective of the planet.

The video segment features a dark background dominated by a curved, glowing blue line, resembling a planetary atmosphere. In the top right corner, a rectangular inset image displays a textured, light grey surface. Yellow text overlaid on this surface reads "Cellular nitrogen ice plains", describing the visible geological feature. Below this text, a yellow scale bar indicates "10 miles". The textured surface itself is composed of numerous small, irregularly shaped, bubble-like formations, giving it a cellular appearance.
